p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Decode each 3x3 cell by its non-background color."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for r in range(0, h, 3):
        row = []
        for c in range(0, w, 3):
            colors = [grid[i][j] for i in range(r, min(r + 3, h)) for j in range(c, min(c + 3, w)) if grid[i][j] not in (0, 5)]
            row.append(max(set(colors), key=colors.count) if colors else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),globals())
answer=transform(grid)
print(answer)
print(len(answer), len(answer[0]))
